about_the_game:
It’s John’s House – Demo
A Taste of Terror Awaits

This is the free demo of It’s John’s House — a psychological horror game where spotting anomalies is your only hope of survival.

In this demo, you’ll get a hands-on preview of:

🔹 Two rooms filled with paranormal anomalies
🔹 Anomaly detection gameplay — find what's changed before it's too late
🔹 A brief encounter with Mama, the house's deadly enforcer

Each room includes randomized anomalies for replayability. Expect around 15–30 minutes of gameplay, depending on your observation skills.

This demo is a standalone experience and does not include the full game.

Can you survive John's rules?
Or will She come for you?

content_descriptors.notes: It's John's House features psychological horror with blood and gore (e.g., blood pools and stains on walls). The game includes disturbing themes, supernatural elements, and moments of violence, but no sexual content or nudity. It is intended for players who are comfortable with unsettling imagery and dark, intense horror.

Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4590 / AMD FX 8350
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 970 / AMD Radeon R9 290
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-10600K / AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 2060 / AMD RX 5700
  • Storage: 8 GB available space

short_description: A psychological horror demo with memory-based gameplay. Explore two eerie rooms, identify paranormal anomalies, and survive the house’s deadly rules. But be warned—one wrong move, and She comes for you.
